faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does setup take?
delivery.answer: Basic setup in 2-3 days, full setup including migration typically in 5-7 days.

pricing.question: Google Workspace or Microsoft 365?
pricing.answer: Both have pros and cons. We determine the best fit together based on your team size, tools you use and budget.

revisions.question: How many email accounts can we have?
revisions.answer: Technically unlimited. The practical limit depends on the plan you choose. We help you select the right plan.

maintenance.question: Will my old emails be lost?
maintenance.answer: No. We carefully plan the migration and transfer all your emails, contacts and calendar without any loss.

migration.question: What if I don't have a custom domain yet?
migration.answer: We can assist with domain purchase too. We offer domain acquisition, DNS setup and email configuration as a package.

mobile.question: Can we use it on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. We set it up on iOS and Android. Access is available from all devices.
